WebAssembly modules and JavaScript modules importing each other: cycles,
a dependency that awaits at the top level, globals between WebAssembly
modules, the JS String builtins and string constants, and functions passed
through.

-- cycle.mjs --
import { run } from "./cycle.wasm";
export function f() { return 41; }
export const result = () => run();
-- cycle.wat --
(module
  (import "./cycle.mjs" "f" (func $f (result i32)))
  (func (export "run") (result i32) call $f i32.const 1 i32.add))
-- t1.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { result } from "./cycle.mjs";
p("JavaScript first", () => result());
-- cycle2.mjs --
import { run } from "./cycle2.wasm";
export function f() { return 1; }
-- cycle2.wat --
(module
  (import "./cycle2.mjs" "f" (func $f (result i32)))
  (func (export "run") (result i32) call $f))
-- t2.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { run } from "./cycle2.wasm";
p("WebAssembly first", () => run());
-- tla.mjs --
await 0;
export function f() { return 7; }
-- tla.wat --
(module
  (import "./tla.mjs" "f" (func $f (result i32)))
  (func (export "run") (result i32) call $f))
-- t3.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { run } from "./tla.wasm";
p("awaits", () => run());
-- ga.wat --
(module
  (global (export "g") i32 (i32.const 3))
  (global (export "mg") (mut i64) (i64.const 4)))
-- gb.wat --
(module
  (import "./ga.wasm" "g" (global $g i32))
  (import "./ga.wasm" "mg" (global $mg (mut i64)))
  (func (export "get") (result i32) global.get $g)
  (func (export "bump") (result i64) global.get $mg i64.const 1 i64.add global.set $mg global.get $mg))
-- t4.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { get, bump } from "./gb.wasm";
import * as ga from "./ga.wasm";
p("globals between modules", () => [get(), bump(), bump(), ga.g, ga.mg]);
-- jsglobal.mjs --
export const g = new WebAssembly.Global({ value: "i32", mutable: true }, 9);
export const n = 1.5;
-- jsglobal.wat --
(module
  (import "./jsglobal.mjs" "g" (global $g (mut i32)))
  (import "./jsglobal.mjs" "n" (global $n f64))
  (func (export "get") (result f64) global.get $g f64.convert_i32_s global.get $n f64.add))
-- t5.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { get } from "./jsglobal.wasm";
p("a WebAssembly.Global from JavaScript", () => get());
-- strings.wat --
(module
  (import "wasm:js-string" "length" (func $len (param externref) (result i32)))
  (import "wasm:js/string-constants" "hello" (global $h externref))
  (func (export "len") (param externref) (result i32) local.get 0 call $len)
  (func (export "hello") (result externref) global.get $h))
-- t6.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { len, hello } from "./strings.wasm";
import source s from "./strings.wasm";
p("string builtins", () => [len("abcd"), hello()]);
p("their imports", () => WebAssembly.Module.imports(s).length);
-- through.mjs --
export function f() { return 1; }
-- through.wat --
(module
  (import "./through.mjs" "f" (func $f (result i32)))
  (export "f" (func $f))
  (global (export "fr") funcref (ref.func $f)))
-- t7.mjs --
import { p } from "./harness.mjs";
import { f as jf } from "./through.mjs";
import { f, fr } from "./through.wasm";
p("a function passed through", () => [f === jf, fr === f, f()]);
-- want --
JavaScript first -> 42
t1.mjs -> ok
WebAssembly first -> 1
t2.mjs -> ok
awaits -> 7
t3.mjs -> ok
globals between modules -> [3, 5n, 6n, 3, 4n]
t4.mjs -> ok
a WebAssembly.Global from JavaScript -> 10.5
t5.mjs -> ok
string builtins -> [4, "hello"]
their imports -> 0
t6.mjs -> ok
a function passed through -> [false, true, 1]
t7.mjs -> ok
